answer: Every claim climbs the knoll of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the horizon re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. By the signal of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, released only after three unrelated confirmations, rewards vest against future work. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
